title: MS Teams integration cannot be moved to another project: PUT answers 400 'Project mismatch'
manual_steps: Create projects A and B that you administer, and an MS Teams integration in A
Open the integration, change its Project to B and save (or PUT /v1/settings/project/<id> with project_name = B)
Observe 400 'Project mismatch' instead of the integration appearing in B
List MS Teams integrations of B: the integration is not there
expected: 2xx; the integration moves to B (R-5, owner answer Q2 a)
siblings: TC-003: the same validator error masks the R-10 singleton rejection in an occupied project
